WITRON Group specializes in intralogistics and automation systems for distribution centers. The Junior IT Developer will support the Material Flow Control team by developing, configuring, testing, deploying, and documenting software that controls warehouse material movement and integrates hardware with the WITRON Warehouse Management System.

Responsibilities
Working together with the responsible team-lead or project-lead to create technical solutions for our existing WWMS application. Areas of work include, for example routing configuration for new warehouses, traffic analysis, coding new or improving existing action point handling, debugging or researching reported issues or questions around traffic routing, developing new and expanding existing interfaces to add features and new support new hardware components
Development, testing, and deployment of change requests, projects, assignments in a collaborative international team environment or working individually on isolated issues
If you see something, say something: Supporting and improving existing and/or new applications and functionalities
Creation of technical documents and specifications for your solutions to allow maintainability of your software
Collaborating with our analyst team on topics that come up during project ramp-up, development, testing and after final acceptance
All hands on deck during on-site project commissioning and ramp-up. You’ll be working on north American based projects (USA and Canada)
Limited communication with clients within the respective field and independent decision-making based on knowledge level
Based on experience, knowledge level, and personal preference responsibilities will be expanded to never run out of interesting tasks

We value team players, practical experience, problem-solving ability, “Can do”-Attitude and a great personality - whether you learned through school, self-study, online courses, or hands-on project
Bachelor's degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent experience combined with some educational experience
Experience should include project design, coding, testing, delivery and technical documentation of GitHub projects, or personal coding examples, class projects or previous professional assignments

This is primarily an in-office position when not travelling
